Presenting the full video song "Tu Raja Ki Raj Dulari" from the Bollywood movie 'Oye Lucky Lucky Oye' featuring Abhay Deol, Paresh Rawal, Neetu Chandra. The song is sung by Rajbir and the music is composed by Sneha Khanwalkar. The lyrics are written by Mange Ram.
Song - Tu Raja Ki Raj Dulari
Film - Oye Lucky Lucky Oye
Singer - Rajbir
Lyricist - Mange Ram
Music Director - Sneha Khanwalkar
Artist - Abhay Deol, Paresh Rawal, Neetu Chandra, Archana Puran Singh, Manu Rishi, Richa Chadda, Anurag Arora, Manjot Singh, Rajinder Sethi, Amandeep Singh Bakshi
Music On - T Series
